name: provenance-label
title: Provenance Label
description: A label that stays on a picture, a video or a 3D view and says what it is (a photograph, a reconstruction, made by a model), with a popover for its sources, placed so the media's own controls can never cover it.

meta.when: A reader must not mistake what they are looking at: a reconstruction beside a photograph, a generated picture, an artist's impression, archive footage. Two placements. ProvenanceFrame puts the label in its own strip above the media, outside the media's box, where nothing the media draws can reach it: use this by default. `position` puts it over a top corner inside the media's box, above its controls and on a solid ground: use this when the label must also stay in full screen, with the label inside the element that goes full screen. The bottom edge is left to controls and captions. For the source of one fact in text use fact-row's SourceChip; for a key of classes inside a scene use certainty-legend.
meta.example:
// In its own strip above the media Drawn from the 1890 survey and two photographs. The roof is a guess.

}>Imagined reconstruction // Over a corner of a player, so it stays in full screen Imagined reconstruction …
